runs.text: Teach me how to sort [7, 3, 5] using swaps. Show the array changing and ask me one question before giving its answer.

beats.say: Here is our array: seven, three, five. We will use bubble sort with swaps.
Compare the first two values. Seven is greater than three, so they must swap.
Now three comes before seven. Next, compare seven and five.
Seven is greater than five, so swap them. Now the array reads three, five, seven.
Quick check: after one full pass, is the array fully sorted yet?
Yes, it is. Three, five, seven is in order.
Recap: we compared neighbors, swapped when out of order, and ended sorted: three, five, seven.

beats.say: We start with seven, three, five. Compare the first pair.
Seven is greater than three, so we swap them.
Now compare seven and five. Seven is greater, so swap again.
Three is now first. We scan again: three and seven are in order.
Seven and five need a swap—wait, we already did that. Let me check: is the array sorted?
